definitions.gloss: blasting, demolition by explosion, blowing up
definitions.explanation: Destroying something by means of explosives. Used for controlled demolition of buildings, mining operations, and military or criminal destruction.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いビルを{爆破|ばくは}{解体|かいたい}した。
examples.english: The old building was demolished by controlled explosion.

examples.japanese: {爆破|ばくは}{予告|よこく}があり、{周辺|しゅうへん}が{封鎖|ふうさ}された。
examples.english: A bomb threat was made, and the surrounding area was sealed off.

examples.japanese: ダムの{建設|けんせつ}のため、{山|やま}の{一部|いちぶ}を{爆破|ばくは}して{岩|いわ}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く{作業|さぎょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: To build the dam, blasting work was carried out to remove rock from part of the mountain.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a noun and suru-verb ({爆破|ばくは}する). Used for both controlled demolition ({爆破|ばくは}{解体|かいたい}) and criminal/military destruction. In news reports, {爆破|ばくは}{予告|よこく} (bomb threat) is a frequently seen compound.

Compared to {爆発|ばくはつ} (explosion), {爆破|ばくは} emphasizes the intentional act of destroying something with explosives, while {爆発|ばくはつ} focuses on the explosion event itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆破|ばくは}{解体|かいたい}: demolition by explosion
- {爆破|ばくは}{予告|よこく}: bomb threat
- {爆破|ばくは}{事件|じけん}: bombing incident
- {爆破|ばくは}する: to blow up, to blast
- {発破|はっぱ}をかける: to set a blast charge (related term)
